name: Probe (Terpometer V1)
description: Contact thermocouple touches the interior quartz floor. Reads interior SURFACE TRUTH directly via physical conduction.
calibration_note: No offsets applied — your reading IS the interior surface temp. Setpoint = concentrate.surface_temp_optimal_f directly.

name: IR Thermometer (Dab Rite Pro v2.2, Octave, Terpometer Gen 2)
description: Non-contact infrared thermopile. Aim per banger geometry — bucket-class reads the exterior floor (cooler than interior during cooldown), slurper-class reads side-of-column (closer to interior). Firmware ε_set = 0.95; clear quartz ε_actual ≈ 0.92.
calibration_note: Apply both dT_Gradient (banger geometry) and dT_emissivity (firmware-vs-material bias). The 0.03 emissivity mismatch causes the sensor to UNDER-report by ~15°F at typical dab temperatures. Workflow: dab on descent through target, NOT at peak torch.

name: E-Nail PID Setpoint
description: Coil temperature controller. Set-and-forget. Coil reads 30-80°F higher than interior surface (varies by brand). emissivity_bias_f here is repurposed for the coil-vs-surface offset midpoint.
calibration_note: Add ~50°F midpoint to surface_temp_optimal_f. MiniNail-on-MiniNail is factory-calibrated to display surface temp directly — set PID to surface target, not the +50°F estimate. Other brands: tune via test dabs.

name: No Thermometer (Visual / Timing)
description: Glow + count method. Approximate. App estimates from form factor and cooldown_seconds.
calibration_note: Use IR-equivalent values as approximate guidance. Visual cue (banger.visual_cue) is the primary signal.
